quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Efzimfotase alfa showed numerical improvement in Six-Minute (10-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HICKORY Phase III open-label extension (efzimfotase alfa, hypophosphatasia): patients continuing efzimfotase alfa had clinically meaningful improvements in Six-Minute Walk Test distance (≥43 metres in adolescents, ≥31.1 metres in adults) at week 37 (mean [SD] change from week 1: 44.1 [60.3] metres) and at week 49 (mean [SD] change from week 1: 61.9 [78.4] metres); patients switching from placebo to efzimfotase alfa had clinically meaningful improvements at week 49 (mean [SD] change from week 25: 43.0 [71.0] metres). In the pooled analysis of the MULBERRY and HICKORY trials, including data from the open-label extension, patients treated with efzimfotase alfa achieved a median of 98.8% injection-site-reaction-free days while on treatment.
quarterly_data.figure: 6MWT mean change from week 1: 44.1 metres at week 37, 61.9 metres at week 49; switchers 43.0 metres (week 25 to week 49); median 98.8% ISR-free days
